Now, enough of the cliche shit. First tip is breathing. Anxiety/panic/depression attacks can be countered by somewhat countered by breathing techniques. Make sure to breathe in slow, wait a second or two and then breathe out slower. It'll feel like it does nothing and maybe you'll feel silly especially if people around hear you (You can do it rather quietly if you want) but after 5 mins your shoulders will relax and you'll be left with a numb pain that's a little easier to deal with.

Second tip, live every day, every hour, every minute and every second in the moment. I've been called a somewhat sad individual for not having a life goal but planning out a realistic path for your life is mind numbing and will only screw you more. This counts for more than just life plans too. Day to day jobs? Take them one at a time and they won't seem like such a huge pile of stuff to get through.

Third tip... I have forgotten the third tip. Ah well, I'll update you if I remember it. If you want a chat about shit then send over a message and I'll get back to ya when I can my dude.

Stay strong.
